lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Today is yet another

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: blessed day,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: because I prayed for you.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But there are always these... impure thoughts...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Um... never mind that! Just my mind playing tricks on me, hehe.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I thought sending you a message

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: might help put my mind at ease.
Anything I can do for you?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hmmm...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Free my mind of these indecent thoughts.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: So why don't you tell me about your day?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: For example, when you got up this morning,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: did you stop to ponder what your condition was?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Have you relieved yourself of it? Hehehe!
Somehow, I don't think that'll help much.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hehe, I suppose you're right. Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But honestly, talking with you is much better

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: than letting my own imagination run wild.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: You know what? When I was praying this morning,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I envisioned you having me up against a wall

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: to the point where I can hardly move. Well, it's not like I wish to anyway...
I think talking to me is only going to make things worse.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Actually,

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: another solution would be to wander on the surface

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: and focus on saving as many Nikkes as possible.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Nevertheless, indulging in my fantasies with you...

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Um... I mean, chatting with you like this makes me happy. Haha.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Gotta go back to work.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: May the blessing of God be upon you always.
